neighbours.label: doing it oneself: the token just before 'of your own', 'into their own hands' or 'yourself'; the + pole is the other side, leaving it to others
fire: Readers are welcome to post recipes of their own in the comments.
When the city ignored the pothole, the neighbours took matters into their own hands.
To cut costs, we did the whole installation ourselves.
The author invites you to draw conclusions of your own.
He had a few problems of his own to worry about that winter.
If you want to save money, handle the paperwork yourself.
Instead of calling a plumber, she repaired the leak herself.
Some students prefer to run the experiments on their own.
quiet: Readers are welcome to post recipes from magazines in the comments.
When the city ignored the pothole, the neighbours called the council again.
To cut costs, we hired a cheaper firm for the installation.
The author tells you the conclusions in the final chapter.
He had a few problems with the neighbours to worry about that winter.
If you want to save time, leave the paperwork to an agent.
Instead of fixing the leak, she called a plumber.
Some students prefer to have a tutor run the experiments.

short: doing it oneself (vs leaving it to others)
